symptom: The per-series ranking table kept the first series it ever rendered while every surrounding panel reported the newly selected one.
root_cause: DT's binding stashes a value and returns without drawing whenever the output element has zero size, flushing it only on a later resize. V6.24 sections are CSS-toggled, and this is the only V6.24 table whose data always changes while its own section is hidden.
fix: v6_24_dt() gained an opt-in lazy_render argument; v24mfc_top5 passes lazy_render = FALSE.
verified_by: Four consecutive Viewer changes read back from the browser and matched the artifact values exactly (806.7471 / 8,420.894 / 4,068.416 / 14,480.88).

symptom: A typed forward-looking question such as 'what will HDD be next quarter' was answered with the legacy-comparison text.
root_cause: The comparison rule matches the bare token 'hdd' so it can catch 'what changed from the old HDD Champion page', and it ran before any out-of-scope guard.
fix: Added an mc_out_of_scope intent ahead of the comparison rule that declines and redirects to V6.24 MVP - Forecast.
verified_by: 13 routing cases re-checked in R and 4 re-checked in the browser; all 7 required prompts still route correctly.
